name: 66603 · Topeka, KS
findings: ZIP 66603 (Topeka) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66603 (Topeka) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
59% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
